À Calvão.definition: A [portuguese] [expression] that refers to the utmost [perfection]. When performing any given action, saying that you did it "À Calvão" means that you achieved perfectness and the unsurmountable.
À Calvão.example:
If you score very high in a test [you say]: "I did it À Calvão."

When you roll a perfect joint [you say]: "[This is a] À Calvão style joint!" or "This joint is really À Calvão".

Àrèmu.definition: A name that only Kings and Princes bear. The name Aremu has the ability to make anyone that bears it proud. Aremus are [intelligent], talented individuals. They have a special ability to win a lot of hearts and fashion those hearts to loving them [especially] girls. Any girl in a [relationship] with a guy that bears Àrèmú should never let him go.
Àrèmu.example: [I love that] boy Àrèmu is a [good] [lover].

ÀREA SINISTRADA.definition: An all famous poem Written by Carla Mirandes. This is part of the [wonderful] [Portuguese Poetry] of [Portugal].
